description: This file defines the DgContainer class within the PhpSpreadsheet library's Shared/Escher namespace. It manages drawing container properties such as IDs and shape indices, and handles a related SpgrContainer. It includes getter and setter methods, and throws an exception if the spgrContainer is unexpectedly null.

classes.name: DgContainer
classes.description: Class managing drawing group container properties such as IDs and associated shape/container objects, with methods to access and modify these properties.

methods.name: getDgId
methods.description: Returns the drawing ID, which is a 1-based index.

methods.name: getLastSpId
methods.description: Returns the last shape ID in the drawing.

methods.name: setLastSpId
methods.description: Sets the last shape ID in the drawing.

methods.name: getSpgrContainer
methods.description: Returns the associated SpgrContainer if set, or null.

methods.name: getSpgrContainerOrThrow
methods.description: Returns the associated SpgrContainer or throws an exception if it is null.

methods.name: setSpgrContainer
methods.description: Assigns a SpgrContainer to this DgContainer.
